capacity.countingRule: 206 physical equipment positions = 200 IT/sellable cabinets + 6 CDU cabinets. CDU cabinets are auxiliary liquid-cooling infrastructure and must not be counted as sellable IT cabinets.
capacity.headerLine: 20 IC8000 pods × 10 IT cabinets + 6 CDU · 110 m × 46 m
capacity.itLoadRule: IT load must be calculated from the final air/liquid IT cabinet mix, not from 206 physical equipment positions.

revisionNote: Previous customer materials used a 200-cabinet baseline without separating auxiliary CDU cabinets. Current working structure preserves 200 IT cabinets and adds 6 CDU cabinets as non-sellable auxiliary equipment.
